table.name: barrier_importance
table.unit_of_observation: one size tier crossed with one AI-adoption barrier

source.method: Shapley decomposition of the R2 a 7-barrier OLS block adds to E_AI_TANY beyond year effects, fit per size tier on the country-year panel, validated by resampling whole countries.

tier_code.note: Size tier code (SMALL_10_49, MEDIUM_50_249, LARGE_GE250) - the three disjoint bands the model is fit on.

rank.note: The barrier's rank within its tier, 1 = largest Shapley share.

barrier_full.note: Eurostat's own full wording for the barrier.

barrier_code.note: Eurostat indicator code for the barrier (unit PC_ENT_AI_EC).

share_pct.note: The barrier's share of the R2 the barrier block adds beyond year effects. Shares sum to 100 within a tier.

ci_low_pct.note: 5th percentile of share_pct across bootstrap draws (whole countries resampled).

ci_high_pct.note: 95th percentile of share_pct across bootstrap draws.

first_place_rate.note: Share of bootstrap draws in which this barrier ranked first in its tier.

direction_in_model.note: Sign of the barrier's coefficient with the other six barriers and the year held constant.

coefficient.note: The barrier's OLS coefficient in the fitted multivariate model - the one share_pct is decomposed from.

direction_marginal.note: Sign of the barrier's raw, one-at-a-time correlation with adoption. Can disagree with direction_in_model.

corr_with_adoption.note: Raw correlation between the barrier and the adoption rate, one barrier at a time.

tier_mean_pct.note: The barrier's mean citation rate across the tier's country-year panel - the reference point contributions are measured from.

exposure_eu27_pct.note: How widely the barrier is cited EU-wide (Eurostat's own EU27 aggregate), for context beside the share.

n_cells.note: Country-year cells the tier's model was fit on.

n_countries.note: Distinct countries in the tier's fitted panel.

years.note: Survey years in the tier's fitted panel, space-separated.

r2_years_only.note: R2 of a model with year effects only, no barriers.

r2_with_barriers.note: R2 of the full model (year effects + all seven barriers).

r2_adjusted.note: r2_with_barriers, adjusted for the number of parameters relative to n_cells.

delta_r2.note: r2_with_barriers minus r2_years_only - what the barrier block adds beyond year effects. What share_pct is a share of.

lead_share.note: Share of bootstrap draws in which this tier's actual top barrier led.

stability_threshold.note: lead_share must meet or exceed this for tier_published to be true.

bootstrap_draws.note: Number of country-resampled bootstrap draws the model was validated on.

tier_published.note: False where the tier's leading barrier is not reliably leading across bootstrap draws - the ranking should not be presented as settled.

outcome_code.note: Eurostat indicator code for the outcome (AI adoption).

outcome_unit.note: Unit the outcome is measured in (share of all enterprises).

exposure_unit.note: Unit the barriers are measured in (share of enterprises that considered AI).

caveats: Association, not causation: the barrier percentages are measured only on firms that considered AI and declined, a population partly defined by the outcome itself. A positive association can be pure composition rather than a driver.
tier_published is false where the tier's leading barrier is not reliably leading across bootstrap draws - do not present that tier's ranking as settled.
